question: In covering a distance of 60 km, Pranay takes 6 hours more than Aman. If Pranay doubles his speed, then he would take 9 hours less than Aman. Pranay's speed is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When Pranay's speed is doubled (ratio 1 : 2), his time is halved (ratio 2 : 1).

Total reduction in Pranay's time = 6 hours (more) + 9 hours (less) = 15 hours.

Difference in time ratio = 2 parts − 1 part = 1 part.

⇒ 1 part = 15 hours ⇒ Original time (2 parts) = 30 hours.

⇒ Pranay's original speed = Distance ÷ Time = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 60 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed
